unit.why: A hasid asks his father to see Elijah, the rest is elided ('וכו''), and the point is the father's teaching that faith in God's all-pervading kingship is itself the revelation of Elijah. A request and a didactic answer do not make a narrative event.
unit.boundary_note: part of a thematic series 'מענין גילוי אליהו' (item ג) spanning previous and next divisions; abbreviated excerpt citing another book ('ע״ק בלקוטים')
